$comment: DSL-specific metadata layered on top of the real, generated ui/common/design-system/catalog.json — childrenParam/dataParam/actionParam/slots/propAssignments are OUR invention, not derivable from JSDoc. Every real catalog component MUST have an entry here (enforced by gen-dsl-catalog.mjs --check). 'status':'ready' components are exposed to the model; 'blocked' ones are excluded, with a reason, until whatever they need exists.

app-table.note: data-fn is set internally by render.js from the dataParam value (a registered-source-name attribute must never be a positional literal the model controls directly)

app-stat-row.note: items is JSON-typed — render.js JSON.stringify's it

app-badge.note: real component is 'CSS-only, content goes in the default slot' — its visible text is light-DOM content, not an attribute; found live (empty-looking badges) and fixed

app-tag.note: real component's own docs: 'the label is whatever you put in the element' — light-DOM text, not an attribute

app-card.note: navigation attrs excluded — no real internal-route allowlist yet (frontend Problem 2); agent-id excluded too, since the real component's own doc says it alone "drives the default hrefs" — passing it re-creates the same unguarded links through a side door even with href/details-href/chat-href blocked (confirmed live: real navigation links rendered from agent-id alone). name/description/status/tags/version/loading are all usable. tags must be a plain string or {label} array — never a real component call (e.g. AppTag(...)) nested inside it; render.js now strips one defensively and warns, but the correct fix is not to write it that way.

app-empty-state.note: icon is a plain string attribute (SVG markup); its icon/default slots are not used

app-action-menu.note: items is JSON-typed — render.js JSON.stringify's it

app-chart.note: confirmed via real source (app-chart.js `set data(next)`) that data is a JS property, not an attribute — render.js sets it directly (el.data = value) instead of setAttribute. Accepts either a bare array (row-form charts: hbar/progress) or {labels, datasets} (canvas-form: line/bar/donut).

app-button.note: textParam added after a real bug: the model had nowhere to put the button's visible label (its own JSDoc says 'content goes in the default slot') and was stuffing it into aria-label instead, which is invisible — confirmed live, fixed. href excluded — no real internal-route allowlist yet (frontend Problem 2).

app-avatar.reason: size/filled/interactive/disabled/state are documented but non-functional (observedAttributes doesn't list them) — real component bug, unchanged on feat/update-wc; only image/initials/label/description/alt actually work. Excluded entirely rather than silently expose 5 dead attributes; revisit once the frontend team confirms it's fixed.

app-tabs.reason: needs a two-attribute slot marker (data-tab + data-label per child), our Slot() mechanism only sets one attribute today. Real, small follow-up — not attempted this pass.

app-toolbar.reason: only two slots (start/end), zero non-slot content, and its real slot-marking attribute hasn't been confirmed by reading its source yet (unlike app-modal/app-tabs, not verified this session) — see frontend Problem 6.

auto-complete.reason: its real suggestion source is `window[filterFunctionName](query)` — a different, legacy convention, not compatible with ui/common/core/data-sources.js's real call() registry. Needs its own design, not attempted this pass.

app-loading-bar.reason: driven by global loading-start/loading-end document events, not a compositional dashboard element — doesn't make sense to expose to a layout-generating model.
